name: corr
expr: C1 = corr(X); pe = corr(x, y); sp = corr(x, y, 'type', 'Spearman'); kd = corr(x, y, 'type', 'Kendall'); spt = corr(c, d, 'type', 'Spearman'); kdt = corr(c, d, 'type', 'Kendall');
comment: Sig c=corr(X) / c=corr(X,Y[,'Type',T]). Pearson matrix (single-arg between cols of X; two-arg X.cols x Y.cols). 'Type' Spearman = Pearson of tied (average) ranks; 'Kendall' = tau-b (ties adjusted). corr([1;2;3;4],[1;4;9;16]) Pearson=0.984374 but Spearman=Kendall=1. With ties c,d: Spearman=0.892218, Kendall=0.824958. numkit previously IGNORED 'Type' (always Pearson) -- now honored. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
